name: Clear diagnostics for a malformed swing_arc
body: Review nit on the Anchor: `Anchor` read `end - start` with no guard, so a swing_arc with no `end` (or one directly above the start) gave a NaN arc. Such an entity is skipped with a log line naming the problem.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, for slice 4, from the coordinator's request to keep growing the platformer.

acceptance_criteria: A swing_arc without `end` is skipped with a clear log line and the level still loads
